page.title: Your app's own AI
page.intro: The AI parts of a published app (chat, companions, agents, search by meaning) run with the app's own AI key. The platform's AI builds and edits your app, but apps can't use it once people use them.
page.introHelp: Add the key of an AI service you pay for. Your app's AI steps use it in the preview and in the published app.
page.ownerNote: You run this platform, so while this app has no key of its own, its AI steps use the platform's AI. Add a key here to use your own instead.
page.needsKey: This app has AI steps but no key yet, so visitors see “This app's AI isn't set up yet.” Add a key below.
page.noAiYet: This app has no AI steps yet. Add a key now and AI steps you add later work right away.
page.ready: This app's AI is set up.
page.security: Keys are encrypted on the server. They are never sent to your app's pages or visitors, never written to logs, and never shown again after you save them.

list.title: Connections
list.makeDefaultHelp: AI steps that don't pick a connection by name use the default one.
list.removeConfirm: Remove the AI connection “{name}”? AI steps that use it stop working until you add another key.
list.name: Name: {name}

form.providerHelp: Where your key comes from. Any service that speaks the OpenAI-style API works with the last choice, including your own Ollama or LM Studio.
form.name: Connection name
form.nameHelp: A short name AI steps can pick (for example “speech” for a second key that can talk). Leave it as default for one key.
form.baseUrlHelp: The API address, for example https://ai.example.com/v1. Optional for the named services.
form.apiKeyHelp: Pasted once, then kept encrypted. It is never shown again.
form.apiKeySaved: Saved ({hint}). Leave empty to keep it.
form.modelHelp: The model your AI steps use, as your service names it.
form.chatModelHelp: For chat replies and agents, if different from the main model.
form.visionModelHelp: For steps that look at pictures.
form.speechModelHelp: For reading replies aloud. Without one, pages use the browser's own voice.
form.embedModelHelp: For search by meaning and knowledge bots.

providers.anthropic: Messages API (keys that start with sk-ant-)
providers.custom: Any OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM…)

test.key: The AI service refused the key. Check that it is right and still active.
test.model: The AI service doesn't know that model or address. Check the model name and the address.
test.quota: The AI service says this key is over its limit or out of credit.
test.timeout: The AI service took too long to answer.
test.private: This address is on a private network, which apps on this server can't reach.
test.unreadable: The saved key can't be read any more. Enter it again.

limits.title: Limits
limits.intro: Protects your key from abuse: when a limit is reached, AI steps wait until the hour is over.
limits.perHour: AI requests per hour, for the whole app
limits.perVisitorHour: AI requests per hour, for one visitor

errors.invalid: Some of the information is missing or in the wrong format.
errors.baseUrlMissing: Enter the server's address (for example https://ai.example.com/v1).
errors.baseUrlBad: That address can't be used. Use an http:// or https:// address without a user name or password.
errors.keyBad: That doesn't look like an API key.
errors.saveFailed: The key couldn't be saved. Please try again.
errors.tooManyTests: Too many tests in a short time. Wait a few minutes.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

banner.title: This app's AI isn't set up
banner.body: This app has AI steps. Published apps use their own AI key, not the platform's AI, so these steps don't work until you add one.

dashboard.title: Some of your apps need their own AI key
dashboard.body: Published apps now use their own AI key for their AI parts instead of the platform's AI. Until you add one, visitors see “This app's AI isn't set up yet.”

notice.title: Your app's AI needs your own key
notice.body: This app has AI features. Published apps can't use the platform's AI: add your own AI key (OpenAI, Google Gemini, xAI, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible server) before people use the AI parts.
notice.later: You can add it any time in the app's AI keys.
